risks.summary: Concept inflation — v2 is now an operational protocol (7 phases, 6 artifacts, 5 required pages, provenance UI, 4-tier severity).
risks.mitigation: README now has 'What this costs to adopt' section + 3 smaller-slice options; surfaced before Install.

risks.summary: Schema cost scales with agent count — 6 files per agent under docs/agent-state/<agent>/. No generation/validation tooling provided.
risks.mitigation: Multi-agent guidance added in Phase 1b: split only when independent decisions warrant it; collapse roles by default. Future work: agent-state-init script + jq schema linter.

risks.summary: Deploy churn — every artifact correction triggers a gh-pages mirror push. Active oversight loops will generate many small commits.
risks.mitigation: Could batch via cron deploy; not implemented. For Pages-from-/docs setups (like this dogfood) the mirror is just a regular commit, so deploy churn = repo churn.

risks.summary: v1 reference implementation (yanghangAI/imagehide) no longer matches v2 methodology. Users who copy it verbatim will get the doc-site shape.
risks.mitigation: README now lists this repo (yanghangAI/dashboard-skills) as the v2 reference implementation; imagehide is labeled v1 with explicit 'don't copy verbatim' warning.

risks.summary: TextQuoteSelector anchoring may fail on text rendered dynamically from artifact updates (the very thing the dashboard does most).
risks.mitigation: Patterns 4-6 from v1 carried over; needs real-world stress test. Dogfood deployment is the first test.

risks.summary: Public-passthrough auth mode is not yet in the published methodology — only PAT and OAuth+Worker are documented.
risks.mitigation: Added as third auth mode in Phase 1a; full row in the Auth modes table; pattern-2 and pattern-7 caveats noted in Phase 5; pass-through-specific deploy shortcut in Phase 6.
